questions.stem: Count the sides and inspect the angles of this 2D shape. What is its name, and is it regular or irregular?
questions.hint: First count the number of straight sides (3=triangle, 4=quadrilateral, 5=pentagon, 6=hexagon, 7=heptagon, 8=octagon, 9=nonagon), then check if ALL sides and ALL angles are equal.

keyPoints.note: The number of straight sides determines the polygon name.
Regular = all sides equal AND all angles equal; otherwise irregular.

steps.explain: Number each straight side around the outside of the shape. There are \(3\) sides in total.

questions.stem: In the classic "Join the dots" puzzle, you join all \(9\) dots using \(4\) straight lines without lifting your pencil or going over any line twice. What kind of shape do the \(4\) lines form?
options: A right-angled triangle with an arrow tail (arrow shape)
questions.hint: Think outside the box! Two of the lines must extend PAST the outer dots so they turn sharply and cover the remaining dots, forming a big triangle with a diagonal line inside.

keyPoints.note: Extending lines outside the 3×3 square is the key to solving the 9-dot puzzle.

steps.explain: Line 1 (blue): Start at the top-left dot and draw horizontally across the top row, extending ONE unit PAST the top-right dot.
